connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.2.13: 'Archivio' (All) discovery now pages via the site's own catalogue endpoint (POST /archivio/get-animes, limit/offset, up to 25 pages) with the public source session (CSRF+cookie bootstrap) - fixes the section stopping after the first 30 titles while scrolling. Added the remaining poster CDN hosts. Streams unchanged from 0.2.12 (literal-selection HLS graph).

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
